title: deployment/1 — what is deployed: one method, its gates, for one pair
description: A deployment is the eval pipeline on source-only input (founder, 2026-10-09): the SAME document is tested on a test set (mt-eval run --deployment), run over a file (mt-eval translate --deployment) and served (mt-eval serve --deployment), so what was measured is what ships. Paths are relative to the project's root (where the rails run commands). It names no score: a measured number is a run result, kept with the run.

source.description: The source language's code (ISO 639-3 or BCP-47).

target_script.description: The script the output is written in (ISO 15924), for a gate that checks it — a server has no references to read it from.

method.description: The method: an engine name (lexicon, local-model, …) or a method plugin's folder, with the model or dictionary it runs. Served only if it runs in this process.

model.description: The model, model folder or dictionary file it runs.

gates.description: A gate-chain/1 file: every segment is gated before it ships (and before it is scored).

host.description: Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only). Another host needs a token from the environment.
